remarks:
Investor opportunity in a great Buffalo location! This 4-bedroom, 2-bath double-family home is located just ¼ mile from vibrant Larkinville and offers excellent potential for an investor, contractor, or owner looking for a renovation project.

The upper apartment offers an easier renovation, while the lower apartment has been taken down to the studs, providing a blank canvas for a complete rehab and the opportunity to design the space to your specifications.

Situated on a double lot, the property offers valuable outdoor space and off-street parking, adding convenience and appeal for future tenants. The location puts you close to Larkinville, downtown Buffalo, restaurants, entertainment, employment centers, and major roadways.

Whether you’re looking to rehab and hold, renovate and rent, or create a profitable investment property, 628 Fulton Street offers the space, location, and potential to make your vision a reality.

Cash or rehab loan preferred. Property is being sold in its current condition. Bring your contractor and explore the possibilities!

Highlights:
• 4 bedrooms / 2 bathrooms
• Two-family property
• Upper apartment needs easier renovation
• Lower apartment down to studs
• Double lot
• Off-street parking
• Approximately ¼ mile to Larkinville
• Excellent Buffalo location
• Ideal rehab/investment opportunity
• Cash or rehab financing preferred
• Sold as-is
